The plan assumes that neither channel changed how it books orders during the quarter. The data cannot test this. The monthly splits show a stable direct-minus-partner gap of 0.10 to 0.13 in completion and 21.9 to 24.9 EUR in AOV, which is consistent with the assumption but does not prove it.

The claims are associational: channel is not randomised, so the completion and AOV differences between channels must not be read as a causal effect of the channel in the release. The register itself contains no causal wording.
